free_tier.stated: The pack's cloud-credit headline is gone. Quoted from the official pack changelog dated July 7, 2026: "DigitalOcean is leaving the Student Developer Pack, and their student credit offer for $200 of platform credit will no longer be available after July 31, 2026." Any remaining credits expired on 2026-08-01.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Nothing durable. What remains in the pack is a set of one-shot coupons, mostly software licences rather than compute, and each starts a clock when redeemed.
limits_note: Two doors close: the USD 200 DigitalOcean credit ended on 2026-07-31, and the whole pack requires verified full-time student status at an accredited institution, which a user does not hold.

evidence.proved: entry dated 2026-07-07: the DigitalOcean USD 200 student credit ends after 2026-07-31 and remaining credits expire on 2026-08-01, quoted
a 2026 tracker records DigitalOcean as discontinued and calls the USD 200 credit claim stale
on 2026-09-06 the offers page no longer listed DigitalOcean, and the author notes GitHub's own docs say some partner offers cannot renew

notes: Recorded as dead for the compute credit rather than for the pack, which still exists. The DigitalOcean offer page now redirects to the homepage and a new account gets USD 5 for 90 days, which is the trial that replaced USD 200.
